title: Scalar objects in discrete integer representations
statement: Let R be a ring and G a topological group. Discrete continuous R-linear representations of G [def-exc-discrete-modules-category] are equivalent to scalar objects over R in discrete continuous integer representations of G. The equivalence preserves underlying abelian groups and the G-action, and thus preserves the open-stabilizer condition.

source.place: Tag 04JQ, lemma-equivalence-abelian-sheaves-point, scalar enhancement; Tag 04JM, lemma-global-sections-point

proof.text: Restrict an R-representation to its canonical integer module, retaining its G-action. Scalar multiplication gives G-equivariant integer-linear endomorphisms, because each G-action operator is R-linear. Morphisms remain scalar-compatible.

source.place: Tag 04JQ, lemma-equivalence-abelian-sheaves-point, scalar enhancement; Tag 04JM, lemma-global-sections-point

proof.text: Given an integer representation with scalar endomorphisms, forget to its abelian group and apply ModuleCat.mkOfSMul to these endomorphisms. Equivariance of the scalar endomorphisms proves R-linearity of every G-operator. Carriers and G-operators are unchanged, so stabilizers remain open. The identity maps give both natural inverse isomorphisms.
